name: Chiyoda (Hiroshima, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Chiyoda town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly.
history: Flag of the former town of Chiyoda in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-01.

features.role: Chiyoda town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly
